jobs.name: 绯绒小恶魔
jobs.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Input image is the approved complete visual direction board. Convert its candidate popup art into ONE production RGBA skin asset, NOT another concept board. Preserve exact mascot identity, palette and accessory design from the reference. Remove ALL text, letters, numbers, highlights, separators, labels, swatches and ornamental study samples. Exactly one girl and one blank framed panel. Genuine alpha-transparent background outside the art, no checkerboard drawn in, no solid outer backdrop or shadow rectangle. The ENTIRE writing panel must be solid opaque flat color with no holes or fades. Clean anime lines, bold readable shapes; keep original illustration quality. Every ear, horn, tail, wing and ornament fully inside the image with at least 2% transparent margin. Do not crop the character. Do not create any extra character. Preserve the approved crimson velvet / charcoal / champagne gold design, ivory opaque paper panel, black-and-gold thin border, oversized red silk bow with gold bell. Exact same tiger girl: orange hair, amber eyes, black striped tiger ears and tail, TWO small black curved devil horns, black bat wings, red velvet capelet, ivory ruffled blouse, dark skirt, red bow and bell. Horizontal pose rests chin on one hand and holds a small golden trident. Vertical pose peeks around frame with her hands, full clothed small figure, no new costume. Keep the big red bow and bell at the upper-left corner. Its trailing ribbons must stop ABOVE the middle of the panel side. A small black bat wing may sit at the upper-right corner. Thin champagne corner curls below, not halfway along the side. No giant wing at bottom. HORIZONTAL asset: wide 2:1 canvas. Long shallow framed blank candidate panel runs from x=4% to96%, y=59% to91%; nearly straight thin horizontal top and bottom rails with modest rounded corners. Large tiger-girl ABOVE the right half, filling x=55%..94% and y=4%..61%; she rests on the top rim, with her face large and readable. Complete head, horns and ears fit above. Preserve character size rather than filling empty left space with decorations. The vertical strip x=23%..47% must contain ONLY plain straight horizontal frame rails and blank opaque paper, transparent above/below; NO character, hair, wing, bow, flame, spark or anything in this stretchable strip. The horizontal strip y=72%..79% must contain ONLY straight left/right vertical frame rails and blank opaque paper, transparent outside. This second band must be free of ALL decorations across the ENTIRE canvas, enabling safe vertical expansion for two text rows. Corner decorations confined to y<71% or y>81%. No parallel interior horizontal separators.
